device_entry.name: Racal 1992频率计数器
device_entry.description: Racal 1992频率计数器，用于测量输入信号的频率，并支持预置、端口选择以及本地/远程控制切换，适用于电子与仪器实验中的频率测量。
device_entry.description_en: The Racal 1992 is a frequency counter used to measure the frequency of input signals. It supports preset, port selection, and switching between local and remote control for frequency measurement in electronics and instrumentation labs.

schema.description: 测量或读取输入信号频率。
schema.description_en: Measure or read the frequency of the input signal.

schema.description: 执行仪器预置或复位到预设状态。
schema.description_en: Preset the instrument or reset it to a predefined state.
Select the port used for measurement.
Switch the instrument to remote control mode.

schema.description: 切换到本地面板控制模式。
schema.description_en: Switch the instrument to local front-panel control mode.
